reviews.title: Boycotting Claude/Anthropic over Project Panama
reviews.content:
These weren’t just random paperbacks — many were rare and out-of-print editions, irreplaceable pieces of human knowledge and cultural heritage. Once destroyed, they’re gone forever. No amount of “fair use” court rulings changes the fact that physical books with historical and cultural value were permanently destroyed for corporate convenience, and the whole project was deliberately kept secret from the public.

Anthropic markets itself as the “responsible” and “safety-focused” AI company. This kind of quiet, large-scale destruction of cultural artifacts doesn’t match that image at all. I’d rather support companies that are transparent about how they source training data and that don’t treat books — physical, irreplaceable objects — as disposable scraps.

Uninstalling. Won’t be back until there’s real accountability.
